description: We are TechVerse, a team passionate about technology, space exploration, and innovation. Our project, Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer, aims to make space learning interactive and exciting for young minds. We welcome creative thinkers and enthusiastic learners with skills in programming, web development, UI/UX, 3D modelling, AI/ML, astronomy, and research. Beginners are welcome too! Let's learn, collaborate, innovate, and reach for the stars together! 🚀
